title: SonarLLM: A Native Sonar--Optical Multimodal Large Language Model for Underwater Perception
abstract: arXiv:2608.24325v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reliable underwater perception requires complementary sensing under variable visibility. Optical cameras capture appearance and semantics but degrade rapidly with turbidity, whereas imaging sonar preserves geometry while exhibiting distinct range-azimuth structure and acoustic artifacts. Existing MLLMs, built primarily on optical encoders, are therefore ill-suited to model sonar or adaptively exploit sonar-optical complementarity. We propose SonarLLM, a sonar-optical MLLM that treats sonar as a native perceptual modality. It combines a sonar-specific encoder, modality-specific physics-aware feature enhancement, and reliability-aware hierarchical fusion to align acoustic structure with optical semantics and dynamically adjust their contributions as sensing quality changes. translated_title: SonarLLM：一种用于水下感知的原生声呐-光学多模态大语言模型
translated_abstract: 可靠的水下感知需要在可变能见度条件下进行互补感知。光学相机能够捕捉外观和语义信息，但在浑浊环境中会迅速退化，而成像声呐则能保留几何结构，同时展现出独特的距离-方位结构和声学伪影。现有的多模态大语言模型主要基于光学编码器构建，因此不适合建模声呐数据或自适应地利用声呐-光学互补性。我们提出了SonarLLM，一种将声呐视为原生感知模态的声呐-光学多模态大语言模型。它结合了声呐专用编码器、模态特定的物理感知特征增强以及可靠性感知的分层融合，以对齐声学结构与光学语义，并根据传感质量变化动态调整其贡献。我们还引入了SonarBench，一个配对基准数据集，涵盖四个任务：识别、计数、视觉问答和图像描述；在基准测试中，该模型表现出色。
tldr: 本文提出SonarLLM，首个将声呐作为原生模态的多模态大语言模型，通过物理感知特征增强和可靠性感知融合，并结合SonarBench基准，实现了声呐-光学互补的水下感知。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SonarLLM, the first multimodal large language model treating sonar as a native modality, using physics-aware enhancement and reliability-aware fusion with the SonarBench benchmark to achieve sonar-optical complementary underwater perception.
